# Open Keychain 3D

> Open Keychain 3D is a browser-based, open-source customizer for printable 3D keychains,
> nameplates, plant labels, and related small objects.

Geometry generation and STL/3MF export run locally in the browser. WebMCP is a progressive,
native-only enhancement: supported browsers may register tools while `/create` is open. The
optional API server is not required for the customizer workflow.

## Product

- [Open Keychain 3D](https://open-keychain.com/) — product home and localized content.
- [Customizer](https://open-keychain.com/create) — create and export a printable design.
- [Privacy](https://open-keychain.com/privacy) — privacy and analytics information.

## Templates

- [Template catalog](https://open-keychain.com/templates/) — browse printable design templates.
- [Name keychain](https://open-keychain.com/templates/name-keychain/) — a standard name keychain.
- [Articulated name](https://open-keychain.com/templates/articulated-name/) — linked articulated letters.
- [Nameplate](https://open-keychain.com/templates/nameplate/) — a rounded embedded nameplate.
- [Plant label](https://open-keychain.com/templates/plant-label/) — a printable garden label.

## Guides

- [Guide catalog](https://open-keychain.com/guides/) — printing and format guidance.
- [STL vs 3MF](https://open-keychain.com/guides/stl-vs-3mf/) — choose an export format.
- [How to print a name keychain](https://open-keychain.com/guides/how-to-print-a-name-keychain/) — prepare a print.
- [Articulated vs standard keychain](https://open-keychain.com/guides/articulated-vs-standard-keychain/) — compare templates.
- [Printable plant label guide](https://open-keychain.com/guides/printable-plant-label-guide/) — make a plant label.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/capynq/open-keychain) — the open-source repository.
- [MIT license](https://github.com/capynq/open-keychain/blob/main/LICENSE) — project license.
- [WebMCP implementation](https://github.com/capynq/open-keychain/blob/main/docs/webmcp.md) — native tool integration and security boundaries.
